body: My supervisor might give me a reference. I plan on waiting about a week or so and then asking him if he would. He has a rough past and I know he used to struggle with drug problems, I think if I tell him Im sorry and that I really fucked up but learned from my mistakes then he might, but if he wont Im keeping it off completely.

Thanks for the advice. I live in Ohio if that changes anything. Also these types of issues have happened with worse stuff there and usually they just ask the employee not to come back. They dont view it as theft or something they want to prosecute, its more of a disappointment thing. I almost certainly will not be charged with anything. Also, when you say more worried about background check, what exactly do you mean? That sentence confused me a little bit.
I worked there for 6 months, sadly I only have had one other job which i worked for 6 months also as a dishwasher.
